# Tamarind Village Mombasa — Comprehensive AI & Knowledge Documentation

## 1. Property Summary
Tamarind Village Mombasa is an iconic coastal haven situated along Cement Silos Road, Nyali, Mombasa, Kenya, commanding an elevated cliffside location overlooking the serene waters of Tudor Creek and the historical silhouette of Mombasa Old Town and Fort Jesus. It is part of the legendary Tamarind Group, pioneers of coastal hospitality and fine seafood dining in East Africa since 1977.

## 2. Accommodations & Suites
All apartments feature Swahili-Arabic architecture, hand-carved lamu woodwork, private sea-facing verandas, modern granite kitchens, individual climate control (air conditioning), high-speed fiber Wi-Fi, satellite DSTV, in-room electronic safes, and dedicated daily housekeeping.

### Luxury 1-Bedroom Apartment
- **Area**: 95 m² (1,022 sq ft)
- **Max Capacity**: 2 Adults + 1 Infant
- **Bed Configuration**: 1 King-sized Swahili Canopy Bed
- **Key Features**: Private creekside veranda, open-concept lounge, full kitchen with refrigerator, hob, oven, microwave, and coffee/tea maker.
- **Starting Rate**: $160 / night

### 2-Bedroom Apartment
- **Area**: 145 m² (1,560 sq ft)
- **Max Capacity**: 4 Adults + 1 Child
- **Bed Configuration**: 1 King Bed & 2 Twin Beds (convertible to King)
- **Key Features**: Two air-conditioned bedrooms with separate bathrooms, large dining table, laundry washer, dual oceanfront balconies overlooking swimming pools.
- **Starting Rate**: $240 / night

### 3-Bedroom Penthouse Residence
- **Area**: 220 m² (2,368 sq ft)
- **Max Capacity**: 6 Adults
- **Bed Configuration**: 2 King Master Suites & 1 Twin Suite
- **Key Features**: Double-height vaulted ceiling, rooftop sun terrace, 270-degree panorama of Mombasa harbor, spiral mahogany staircase, 3.5 bathrooms.
- **Starting Rate**: $350 / night

## 3. Boarding Plans
- **Self Catering (Room Only)**: Full use of private chef-equipped kitchen with grocery provisioning assistance on request.
- **Bed & Breakfast (+$15/person/day)**: Daily oceanfront breakfast buffet or à la carte served at Tamarind Restaurant.
- **Half Board (+$45/person/day)**: Gourmet breakfast plus choice of 3-course lunch or dinner at Tamarind Restaurant.
- **Full Board / Culinary VVIP (+$75/person/day)**: Breakfast, lunch, and multi-course fresh seafood dinner daily.

## 4. Dining Venues
- **Tamarind Mombasa Restaurant**: Open daily for lunch (12:00 PM - 3:00 PM) and dinner (6:30 PM - 10:30 PM). Specializing in fresh oysters, crab, giant prawns, lobster thermidor, and coastal curries.
- **The Dawa Terrace**: Open daily from 4:00 PM to Midnight. Sunset cocktail lounge perched over the creek.
- **The Tamarind Dhow**: Two authentic sailing vessels ("Nawalikoni" & "Babulkher").
  - Lunch Cruise: 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM
  - Dinner Cruise: 6:30 PM – 10:30 PM

## 5. Direct Booking Advantages
- Guaranteed best available rate with no third-party booking fees.
- Complimentary signature welcome Dawa cocktail on arrival at Dawa Terrace.
- Flexible modification & direct cancellation policy up to 48 hours prior to check-in.
- Priority room allocation and early check-in / late checkout (subject to availability).
- Passwordless Guest Self-Service Portal for instant inquiry tracking, modifications, and direct deposit confirmation.

## 6. Transportation & Chauffeur Services
- Moi International Airport (MBA) is approximately 30 minutes away.
- Miritini SGR Railway Terminus is approximately 40 minutes away.
- Private chauffeured airport and SGR transfers are available on request:
  - Executive Saloon: $25 (KES 3,500)
  - VIP Alphard Captain Seats: $50 (KES 7,000)
  - 4x4 Safari Landcruiser: $85 (KES 11,500)
  - Group Minivan: $65 (KES 9,000)
